To whom it may concern,  

I’ve collaborated with Ekaterina Smirnova on two cross-functional projects at FinTech Innovators Inc. over the past year. As a peer developer, I’ve observed her work on 3D graphics optimization and multiplayer networking systems, where her technical rigor and problem-solving approach consistently delivered results.  

Ekaterina’s expertise in 3D graphics, particularly with Vulkan, has been critical to our flagship product’s visual fidelity. She spearheaded a refactor of the engine’s rendering pipeline, reducing GPU memory usage by 22% while maintaining 60fps performance across devices. Her ability to balance artistic goals with technical constraints ensured the feature met both design and performance targets.  

In a high-stakes multiplayer project, she designed a network synchronization system that cut latency by 40% compared to the prior version. Her solution minimized packet loss during peak loads, which was validated through live stress tests. She also mentored junior team members on best practices for state replication, which improved team efficiency without compromising code quality.  

Beyond her technical skills, Ekaterina’s reliability and attention to detail stand out. She consistently prioritizes thorough testing and documentation, which has reduced post-launch bug reports by 15% in her modules. Her collaborative mindset and willingness to iterate on feedback make her a trusted contributor.  

I recommend Ekaterina without reservation. She’s a dependable, results-driven developer with a strong grasp of complex systems.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
